description: A single-panel high-resolution XPS spectrum, labelled (a₃) in the top-left corner, showing the O 1s region of the surface oxide film. The x-axis is "Binding energy (eV)", plotted in the conventional reversed XPS direction from 540 eV (left) to 524 eV (right), with major ticks every 2 eV (540, 538, 536, 534, 532, 530, 528, 526, 524) and minor ticks at the odd values; the y-axis is "Intensity (a.u.)" with no numeric scale printed. A black measured/envelope curve is fitted by three coloured, shaded Gaussian components, each tagged with an arrowed label: a green component labelled H₂O whose apex lies between the 532 and 534 eV gridlines (≈533.5 eV); a tall pink component labelled OH⁻ with its apex between the 530 and 532 eV gridlines (≈531.8 eV), carrying the largest area and dominating the envelope; and a small purple component labelled O²⁻ near 529.8 eV. A flat baseline is drawn in orange beneath the fitted peaks. The relative component areas show the film is dominated by hydroxide with minor oxide and adsorbed-water contributions. No caption was supplied, and no sample label, magnification or scale bar appears in the pixels.

observations.observation: Panel (a₃) is an XPS O 1s spectrum with 'Binding energy (eV)' on the x-axis spanning 540 to 524 eV in reversed order and 'Intensity (a.u.)' on the y-axis.
The black measured O 1s envelope is deconvoluted into exactly three shaded components labelled H₂O (green), OH⁻ (pink) and O²⁻ (purple).
The OH⁻ component has the largest peak area and dominates the overall envelope; its apex lies between the 530 and 532 eV gridlines.
The H₂O component apex lies between the 532 and 534 eV gridlines, i.e. at higher binding energy than the OH⁻ peak.
The O²⁻ component is the smallest of the three fitted peaks, with its apex between the 528 and 530 eV gridlines.
An orange flat baseline is drawn beneath the three fitted components across the full plotted range.
The panel carries the label (a₃) in its top-left corner, indicating it is the third sub-panel of a group labelled (a).
No numeric values are printed on the y-axis, and no peak-area percentages or atomic concentrations are annotated, so the components can only be compared qualitatively.
The x-axis major gridlines are at 540, 538, 536, 534, 532, 530, 528, 526 and 524 eV, with minor ticks at the intervening odd values.
The oxide-film spectrum contains no metal-oxide or metallic-state component other than the three labelled O 1s species (H₂O, OH⁻, O²⁻).

subfigures.description: High-resolution XPS O 1s spectrum, x-axis Binding energy (eV) reversed from 540 to 524 eV, y-axis Intensity (a.u.). A black measured envelope is deconvoluted into three shaded peaks labelled with arrows: H₂O (green, apex between 532 and 534 eV), OH⁻ (pink, apex between 530 and 532 eV, largest area) and O²⁻ (purple, apex near 529-530 eV), over an orange baseline.

unreadable_items: No caption was extracted, so the sample, grain size and solution-treatment condition represented by panel (a₃) cannot be confirmed from the figure
Y-axis intensity is not numerically scaled, so component areas cannot be quantified from the pixels
Exact peak positions of H₂O, OH⁻ and O²⁻ are not printed; only their positions relative to the axis gridlines can be read
